basic_details.job_title: CSB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre (CSGRC), Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, will hold a walk-in interview at 10.00 AM on 3 December 2026 at the Auditorium, Main Office Building, CSGRC, Hosur - Thally Rd, Hosur, Tamil Nadu 635109. The interview is for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the Silkworm Division, with emoluments of Rs. 31,000 + HRA (with NET/GATE) or Rs. 21,000 + HRA (without NET/GATE) for the first two years. Candidates with an M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science or Agricultural Science may attend.

content_sections.heading: About CSB-CSGRC
content_sections.text: The CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre (CSGRC) is a centre of the Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, located at P.B. No.44, Thally Road, Hosur - 635 109, Krishnagiri Dist., Tamil Nadu. The JRF post serves the project BPS06016SIC, "Evaluation of isoprenoid pigments, cocoon carotenoid profiling and associated transport-gene expression in Bombyx mori accessions for biological applications", funded by the Central Silk Board (CSB), Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India. The project runs from Oct, 2026 to March, 2028 (1.5 years).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post, placed in the Silkworm Division of CSGRC-Hosur. Essential: M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from a UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates). Desirable: A candidate having specialization in Biochemistry/ Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/Sericulture with working experience in Biochemistry and Molecular Analysis will be preferred. The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of notification (19/11/2026). The notice does not mention a minimum age. HRA is paid in addition to the fellowship amount. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: At the time of interview, candidates must bring the following documents with two sets of self-attested photocopies: One recent passport size photograph Certificates and mark sheets for all education qualifications (SSLC, PUC/HSC, B.Sc., M.Sc., etc.) Proof of date of birth No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable Certificates/documents related to research experience (if any) Copies of research experience, trainings, publications (if any) Community certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, if applicable) Valid email ID and telephone/mobile number

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may appear for the walk-in interview at the venue at 10.00 AM on 3 December 2026; no application needs to be sent in advance. The recruitment procedure follows the Guidelines for Research Fellow (JRF/SRF/RA) hiring under CSB-coded R&D projects, and the decision of the Director-CSGRC is final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview. The position is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, and co-terminus with the project (Oct, 2026 to March, 2028). Canvassing in any form will lead to the cancellation of candidature. Contact details printed on the notice: e-mail [email protected] , [email protected] ; Phone 04344-222013, 221148; Fax 04344-220520.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CSB-CSGRC JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is at 10.00 AM on 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the CSGRC JRF walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Auditorium, Main Office Building, CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre (CSGRC), Hosur - Thally Rd, Hosur, Tamil Nadu 635109.

faq.question: Q3. How many JRF vacancies are there at CSGRC Hosur?
faq.answer: There is one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the Silkworm Division.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the CSGRC JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from a UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CSB-CSGRC JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of notification, with a relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, Women and Physically Challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the CSGRC JRF?
faq.answer: With NET/GATE it is Rs. 31,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 35,000 + HRA for the third year; without NET/GATE it is Rs. 21,000 + HRA and Rs. 25,000 + HRA respectively.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to the fellowship amount, according to the notice.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the CSGRC JRF interview?
faq.answer: Bring a passport size photograph, education certificates and mark sheets, proof of date of birth, NOC if applicable, research experience documents if any, community certificate if applicable, and a valid email ID and phone number, with two sets of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSB-CSGRC JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary, on a contractual basis and co-terminus with the project running from Oct, 2026 to March, 2028.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview.
